text:
neha: FYI Tom handed in resignation today. Last day 2026-08-12 (four weeks notice). Key items: 401(k) rollover guidance, equity vesting timing/repurchase rights, COBRA (US), license access for paid third-party tools, and laptop return (SF office). Lina, any immediate handover sessions to schedule?

tom: I'll finish the product spec and do three handoff sessions: 2026-08-05 16:00 PDT (roadmap), 2026-08-09 09:00 PDT (okrs), and 2026-08-11 14:00 PDT (final Q&A). Keep GitHub and Figma read access for 72h after offboard for docs.

lina: Noted. We'll archive the active epic and assign remaining tickets to the product backlog owner. Tom, please add final link to figma and flag any license seats we should reclaim.

tom: I have these paid seats: Amplitude (product@redwood.com), Figma (tom@redwood.com), and DataDog (tom@redwood.com). Please reclaim Figma and Amplitude immediately after license transfer; DataDog needs a 30-day overlap for alerts.

it-team: We'll schedule phased offboard: 1) revoke prod API keys 2026-08-12 17:00 PDT, 2) disable workstation login 2026-08-13 09:00 PDT, 3) remove org access 2026-08-15 09:00 PDT. Command: `redwood-offboard --user tom --stages api-lock,workstation-disable,org-remove-delay72h`. Any exceptions?

security: Please confirm if Tom had access to HIPAA data sets or restricted buckets. We need SR-forms on handoff.

lina: Tom had access to anon-prod-benchmarks only, not restricted PHI buckets. He did have a DB read role on analytics-prod for metrics queries. I'll run a quick audit and post results.

comp: Equity: Tom has 10k options, vesting quarterly with next vest scheduled 2026-09-30. He also has repurchase rights per our policy. We need to confirm last day and whether he wants early exercise or to follow standard post-termination election window. Tom, do you plan to exercise?

tom: I'm evaluating. Can comp share the timeline for post-termination exercise and the repurchase offer window? Also any tax docs we need?

comp: Post-termination exercise window: 90 days for standard ISO by plan (unless otherwise specified in your grant). Repurchase rights: company may buy back unvested shares at FMV; vested shares remain exercisable per plan. We'll DM details and attach the grant agreement.

benefits: COBRA applies if you're on US medical plan. Tom, confirm if you're on company medical (yes/no) and whether you want COBRA estimate. Also we'll provide 401(k) rollover guide and vendor contacts (Vanguard/ADP).

tom: Yes I'm on company medical. Please send COBRA estimate and 401(k) steps.

benefits: Will send COBRA election packet within 5 business days with coverage end date 2026-08-12 and election window through 2026-11-10. 401(k): we'll include rollover forms and a Vanguard contact for direct transfer.

security: License seats: we'll deprovision Figma & Amplitude 2026-08-13 10:00 PDT and DataDog 2026-09-11 10:00 PDT per request. Please confirm any dashboards that need reassignment before seat reclaim.

tom: Dashboards reassigned for DataDog. Figma file ownership: please transfer `product-roadmap.fig` to `team-product-admins` before reclaim.

it-team: Noted. We'll transfer file and then reclaim seat.

shipping-bot: Please ship SF laptop back to Redwood HQ Returns. Draft label: From: Tom <tom@example.com> To: Redwood Returns. Service: UPS Ground. Declared: Company asset, USD 1500, HS 8471.30. RMA: RMA-0826-300. Pickup suggested 2026-08-13 14:00 PDT. Confirm customs not needed for domestic.

tom: OK to pickup 8/13. I'll wipe after backup. What's the secure wipe checklist?

security: Secure wipe: 1) backup work data to encrypted offboards S3 `s3://redwood-offboards/tom-2026-08-12` 2) revoke SSH keys & API tokens 3) rotate service tokens he owned 4) factory reset and attach asset serial + damage notes. Please post serial in thread.

tom: Backup done and posted in bucket. Serial: SN-SF-77412.

neha: Admin items: - schedule exit interview (virtual) - prepare final paycheck + any outstanding commission/bonus proration - send COBRA packet & 401(k) rollover pack - confirm license reclaim timeline - run security audit of accesses. I'll assign owners in the checklist.

comp: Final payout: we'll calculate any unpaid bonus/commissions pro-rated to last day and include accrued but unused PTO per policy. Expected payout run: 2026-08-20.

neha: Tom, prefer written feedback or 30-min live exit interview?

tom: 30-min live. 2026-08-10 at 11:00 PDT works.

neha: Scheduling now and will send calendar invite. Please reply here when each task done. :white_check_mark:

it-team: Offboard job queued with run id off-262500-01. Will post completion once executed.

security: Access audit: analytics-prod read role revoked 2026-08-12T17:02:33Z, no PHI access found.

shipping-bot: Pickup confirmed 2026-08-13 14:00 PDT. Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784.

comp: Sent DM with equity & tax timelines and attached grant copy.

benefits: COBRA packet and 401(k) rollover email sent.

neha: Closing loop when final payout posts and device arrives. Thanks team.

tom: Thanks all for support. Appreciate the handoffs.
